title: Exec & Adoption Impact Slate - Starter Pack
content:
Purpose / one-liner:
This is a lightweight, two-track QBR deck starter (Exec Impact track + Adoption/Technical track) designed to: align exec-level value conversations with technical adoption signals, create a clear renewal ask path, and provide a short remediation playbook for at-risk accounts.

Status + how to use this doc:
- DRAFT: meant for Customer Success Managers to fork and adapt per account.
- Use the Exec Impact slides for executive-facing meetings (20–30 mins).
- Use the Adoption slides for deeper technical stakeholders and runbooks (30–45 mins).
- Suggested workflow: send Exec deck 48h before meeting; bring Adoption pack as appendix or follow-up session.

High-level structure (slide order suggestions):
1) Cover + Agenda (1 slide)
2) Exec Snapshot: Outcomes & ROI (2 slides)
3) What changed since last QBR (1 slide)
4) Adoption Health: Signals & Metrics (3 slides)
5) Top Wins & Case Studies (1–2 slides)
6) Risk Signals & Mitigation Plan (1 slide)
7) Renewal Options & Ask (1 slide)
8) Ask: Proposed Commitment + Next Steps (1 slide)
9) Appendix: Technical Adoption Deep Dive (4–6 slides)

Slide-by-slide notes (talk tracks + placeholders)
1) Cover + Agenda
- Slide title: "Account QX — Exec Impact Review"
- Placeholder: logo, date, attendees (name + role)
- Speaker note: "Quick run-through of agenda — we'll first align on outcomes, then dig into adoption signals and recommended next steps."

2) Exec Snapshot: Outcomes & ROI
- Slide 1: "Business Outcomes — last 90 days" => bullets: ARR expansion (USD), key product outcomes (e.g., reduced latency, automated workflows), top 3 customer-facing wins.
  - Visual: single KPI row + 3 charts (growth, CSAT, time-to-value).
  - Sample metrics to include: ARR delta, average monthly active teams, top 5 API routes by volume, cost delta (tokens spend vs production savings).
- Slide 2: "Value Realized — customer narrative" => 2–3 short customer quotes / one-liner evidence of impact.
  - Speaker note: "Tie to specific business levers (e.g., increased conversion, reduced agent handle time). Use dollarized estimates where possible."

3) What changed since last QBR
- One bullet per change: new product routes enabled, model changes, new integrations, outstanding blockers.
- Link to ticket list: use Jira filter (example link in header).

4) Adoption Health: Signals & Metrics (three mini-slides)
- Slide A: Usage & Growth
  - Chart ideas: 90d usage curve, MAU/DAU, tokens per session distribution.
  - Key threshold markers: 3x growth, plateau, decline.
- Slide B: Reliability & Performance
  - p95 latency, error rate, incidents in period, SLO compliance.
- Slide C: Quality & Satisfaction
  - Eval suite pass rate, regression alerts, CSAT/NPS snippets, customer-reported quality incidents.
  - Speaker note: "Call out model/regression guardrails and any recent eval hits."

5) Top Wins & Case Studies
- Short success stories: 1–2 slide templates with problem -> solution -> outcome bullets.
- Suggested visual: before/after metric callouts.

6) Risk Signals & Mitigation Plan (single consolidated slide)
- Top risk categories (prioritized): 1) Adoption stagnation, 2) Budget pressure, 3) Unresolved technical blockers, 4) Quality/regression concerns.
- For each risk, include: signal (what we observed), impact statement, remediation action (owner + ETA).
- Example row: "Adoption stagnation — new users plateaued after initial pilot" => Action: run 4-week enablement cadence w/ SE, create 3 targeted prompts, executive sponsor intro. Owner: Customer Success / SE.

7) Renewal Options & Ask
- Structured as a small table (Exec slide): Option A (standard renew), Option B (growth bundle with reserved capacity/discount), Option C (enterprise + SLA + private deployment) -> list price delta and primary justification.
- Speaker script: "Based on usage trajectory and business outcomes, we recommend Option B. This balances cost predictability with room to scale — proposed commitment X for next 12 months."

8) Ask: Proposed Commitment + Next Steps
- Conclude with clear next steps: decision deadline, legal/finance contacts, technical enablement timeline, and renewal owner.
- Add quick checkbox list: Exec sign-off, PO submission, kickoff workshop date.

9) Appendix: Technical Adoption Deep Dive (templates for 4–6 slides)
- Slide A: Integration topology (diagram) + open tickets impacting performance.
- Slide B: Prompt engineering & quality examples (sample prompts -> outputs -> suggested tuning).
- Slide C: Cost optimization snapshot (batching, quantization recommendations, KV cache savings estimate).
- Slide D: Risk remediation playbook (runbook steps, escalation path, 2-week tactical sprint).

Renewal Ask Framework (short algorithm for pick recommendation)
- If ARR growth > 25% YOY and adoption > 60% of target features -> Recommend Growth Bundle (mid-tier).
- If technical blockers exist with >2 Sev2 incidents last 90 days -> Defer ask until remediation + consider short-term discount + SLA pilots.
- If heavy security/compliance needs + sensitive data -> Recommend Enterprise plan (private deploy + KMS) and start procurement 60d ahead.

Sample renewal scripts (exec-facing)
- Positive/low friction: "You're seeing $X in realized value and usage trending up — we'd like to recommend the Growth Bundle to remove friction and lock in pricing. Can we target sign-off by DATE?"
- Risk/at-risk: "We've seen a few operational blockers that are limiting adoption. We propose a 90-day remediation + pilot discount — leadership support for the remediation plan will be crucial."

Risk remediation runbook (high-level, copyable)
- T0: Identify signals and categorize (owner: CSM)
- T+24h: Open engineering ticket + SE triage (owner: SE)
- T+72h: Temporary mitigation (feature gate / fallback model) + customer note (owner: SRE/SE)
- T+14d: Deploy fix + validation (owner: Eng + CS)
- T+30d: Follow-up adoption workshop + updated QBR slide (owner: CSM)

KPI scoreboard (text table you can paste into slide)
- ARR movement (USD): "+ $XXX,XXX"
- Active workspaces/teams: "XX -> YY"
- MAU: "NNN"
- API calls / month: "MMMM"
- p95 latency: "XXX ms"
- Error rate: "0.4%"
- Tokens consumption / month: "T millions"
- Cost per 1000 tokens (realized): "$X.XX"
- Regression alerts triggered: "Z"

Templates & assets to copy from (links)
- QBR slide templates (Google Slides starter): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/EXAMPLE_QBR_TEMPLATE
- Renewal SOW checklist (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/CS/Renewal+Checklist
- Jira filter for open customer blockers: https://redwood.atlassian.net/issues/?jql=project%20%3D%20CS%20AND%20customer%20%3D%20%22ACME%22

Meeting cadence suggestions (playbook)
- Pre-QBR prep (2 weeks prior): CSM + SE dry-run, gather metrics, update slides.
- Pre-read distribution: send Exec deck 48h prior with 2-line ask.
- Exec QBR (30 minutes): Exec track only. Reserve time for decision & next steps.
- Technical deep dive (60 minutes): follow-up with adoption stakeholders within 7 days.

Owner RACI (simple):
- CSM: deck owner, renewal negotiation, customer comms.
- Solutions/SE: technical appendix, remediation owner.
- SRE/Infra: reliability metrics + incident context.
- Finance: pricing and billing mechanics.

Quick copy-paste email templates
- Pre-read send: "Hi <exec>, attaching a short exec snapshot covering outcomes and a recommended next step. Would love 30 minutes next week to align — proposed times: [X,Y]."
- Post QBR follow-up: "Thanks for the time. As discussed, we've proposed Option B (Growth). Next step: PO submission by DATE. Tagging owners: <names>."

Open questions / TODOs (internal)
- Decide on example cost-savings metrics to include (Priya to confirm).
- Pull last 90 day token consumption by route (Marco).
- Verify SLO incident list with SRE (Dana).
- Create slide pack variants for: (1) startup / standard, (2) mid-market, (3) enterprise (Samir assigned).

Notes to self (CSM checklist)
- Keep exec deck crisp: 6–8 slides max.
- Avoid technical jargon in exec track; use dollarized outcomes.
- Use appendix liberally for technical folks.

Revision history (light):
- 2025-09-15: initial draft (Aisha)
- 2025-12-04: added renewal ask framework + risk runbook (Marco)
- 2026-02-10: finalized KPI scoreboard layout + email templates (Dana)

Copy / fork guidance:
- Duplicate this doc inside account folder: shared_drives/customer-success/<ACCOUNT-NAME>/QBR and replace metrics table, linked artifacts, and owner section.

End.
